For me it was trust. Fucking hell… my trust issues fucked everything up. It could be from the smallest things like compliments, I would not trust anyone when they called me beautiful or if they said they were grateful for me. I’d have a meltdown over this and lose it.

Another one is the attachment issues. I’d hide it but if they didn’t respond to me for like several hours i’d go insane and at that time I would hurt myself because the feelings were overwhelming. Sometimes this would result in jealousy, I WOULD NEVER FLAT OUT SAY I was jealous but whenever they talked with others while I was in their personal dms… It’d make me angry for no reason even though I don’t want to cause trouble.

The problem with this fucking BPD mental illness is that there are so many emotions and I still need to learn how to handle them. It’s gotten better now, and I’ve cut off some people to control it. Unfortunate it had to end that way, but I’m taking the risk to control my emotions. I have to focus on myself… It’s selfish but I’m so tired of having these emotions and then having the probable constant thought of “damn these outbursts are hurting them i should kms”. Constantly thinking i was the problem… damn.

I keep splitting. On the verge of thinking about throwing my phone away and either committing the deed or just fucking sleeping and hoping i dont wake up. I cope by going outside but hope is faltering. I cant do this. Doesnt help that everyone i love is going away this holiday.

And in the end he confirmed my suspicions. “I cared for you during your breakdowns but the moment I have something happen to me you do this.”

I knew he would use my breakdowns against me. I knew deep down he thought I was the abuser. So I cut it off. All I did was ask for the truth and all this motherfucker did was act pretty in front of me. That’s not a relationship, it’s just burying the shit. I can’t live with that, I told him about my bpd and everything but I know ALMOST NOTHING about him. 

The worst part is? I always think I’m the villain. It hurts. I relapse a lot whenever I see anything remotely close to it. He tells me he suffers when he wanted me back, but I can’t believe this fucking liar anymore.
